content.text:
The New Year campaign ran from January 3 to January 6 (Singapore time) and finished under budget. Total spend was $197.74 of the $200.00 approved.

**Results**

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| A: "Pregnant and setting a 2027 resolution?" (main) | $79.60 | 256,504 | 216 |
| B: "Try 14 days of prenatal workouts for $0" | $59.11 | 176,226 | 144 |
| C: "Only until January 6" | $59.03 | 207,911 | 162 |
| **Total** | **$197.74** | **640,641** | **522** |

Average cost per link click was about $0.38. Trial starts aren't in these numbers, since X can't see them without the pixel. You'll need to send me your trial-start count so I can add it.

**What I set up**

- One campaign, "Tembusu Mama - New Year 2027 Free Trial (Jan 3-6 SGT)", on the existing Amex card. Each post has its own ad group with a daily cap and a total cap: $80 for A, $60 each for B and C, which adds up to $200.
- Objective was link clicks. X has no pixel to optimise trial starts, so the ads were optimised for clicks to your landing page.
- Targeting: iOS only, all countries except Russia and Belarus. No age, interest or language targeting.
- All three posts were approved on the account and all were accepted by X.

**Things to know**

- I monitored the campaign but didn't change anything during the run. Every post kept its original budget and targeting until the end.
- All three posts are in English, and the campaign reached every market except Russia and Belarus. You mentioned localised posts for each market, but the only approved posts were these three English ones. If you want localised versions for other markets, let me know and I can split the campaign by country.
- The campaign ended by its own schedule, so nothing is still running and nothing will spend further.

Once you send your trial-start count, I can add it to this recap.
